changes: Node admission before Web Request/body allocation
Bounded native HTTP bridge used by Fastify and capacity harness
Independent Jev identity and current-only risk requests in TypeScript and Elixir
Classifier calibration and discrimination gates on validation and holdout
Capacity progress checkpoints and OOM diagnostics
limits: Capacity uses local HTTP/1.1 without TLS, production proxy or real model inference.

Live Jev isolation uses test-browser captures and synthetic ablations, not independent identity or human/agent accuracy labels.
Raw operator quality remains experimental; stronger calibration gates do not improve weak ranking by themselves.
No npm or Hex publication in this change.
